Our story
Zambia deserves premium materials, and you shouldn't have to import them yourself.

Nicci Heard, Founder

We exist to make your dream home a reality.

Anyone who has built or renovated in Zambia knows the problem. You want good products, so you end up importing them: waiting on shipping, paying transport, duty and ZRA fees, and hoping what arrives matches the sample.

Slabco Living opened in August 2026 to change that. Nicci started the business out of love for Zambia and a belief that premium surfaces should be available here, at fair prices, with a warranty you can actually call on.

We help builders, renovators and homeowners create beautiful, low-maintenance spaces they feel proud and confident living in.

Questions we hear

Straight answers.

Can I get a discount?

We price fairly from the start, so you won't see inflated prices that we then "discount". For larger projects, builders and developers, ask us about project pricing during your consultation.

What does the warranty cover?

Our surfaces carry 10–15 year warranties depending on the product, and our timber fans carry 5 years. We'll walk you through the terms before you buy and register the warranty for you after installation.

Is quartz or porcelain better for my kitchen?

Both are non-porous and easy to live with. Quartz has a warm, consistent look and suits indoor kitchens. Sintered porcelain handles hot pans and direct sun, so it's the better choice for outdoor kitchens or sunny spaces.

Why not just import it myself?

Importing means shipping time, transport costs, duty and ZRA fees, and no local warranty support if something goes wrong. We hold stock in Lusaka, so you can see the actual slab and get it faster.

Do you work with contractors and developers?

Yes. Builders, contractors and property developers are a big part of who we serve, from single renovations to rental developments and commercial fit-outs.
